common.tagline: A private film club to watch movies with your friends.

landing.pitch: Organise your friends' film nights: propose movies, schedule a session and vote on what to watch. Every club is private, only its members can see it.
landing.noClubText: You are not part of any film club yet.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.storedText: Your name and email when you sign in, and the link to the Google account you sign in with; the clubs you belong to; the films you propose and vote for inside each club; and, if you pick one, a TMDB poster or a TheTVDB cast face as your avatar.
privacy.sharedText: Nobody outside the app. We use Google only for signing in, and TMDB and TheTVDB for film data and avatar images; none of them gets your email beyond what signing in needs. We do not use Gravatar and we do not store your Google photo: your avatar is always something you pick, or the default avatar if you pick nothing.
privacy.deleteText: You can delete your account at any time from <profile>My profile</profile>. That removes your user along with your proposals and votes in every club; nothing of yours is left.

settings.errorDefault: Something went wrong saving your changes
settings.deleteText: Removes your user along with your proposals and votes in every club. This cannot be undone. See the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
